title: Poor quality and terrible instructions
text: Poor quality and terrible instructions. I took a chance with this brand because I have ordered other furniture from them and each had cosmetic flaws. This one is no exception, so at least the brand is consistent in that respect.  However in the case of the other items the assembly instructions were not an issue. This one, though, has the worst assembly instructions, and you will need instructions unless you are super experienced with putting furniture together.  My main complaints is the illustrations are not detailed enough to orient you to which side of a piece is being depicted. And there are whole steps missing.  Frankly I will never purchase another item from this brand. The overall quality is not up to par in my opinion, and parts do not easily line up.
